bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'HOST_TARGET_CHECK=START
'
printf 'POLL_CONTAINER_IDS='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'videobot|creator' | tr '
' ','; printf '
'
printf 'VIDEO_REPO_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD || true
printf 'PAID_MEDIA_SOURCE_FILES='; find . -path '*/src/telegram/paidMedia.mjs' -o -path '*/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs' | head -12 | tr '
' ','; printf '
'
printf 'PAID_MEDIA_RELEVANT='; rg -l 'sendPaidMedia|paid_media|4718' src/telegram scripts 2>/dev/null | head -20 | tr '
' ',' || true; printf '
'
printf 'HOST_TARGET_CHECK=DONE
'
